headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Risk Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency risk analysis to boost the security of npm and PyPI installations, and expand support for binding.gyp command expansion to cover more use cases. Implement a user-friendly interface that highlights potential risks during the installation process.
actions: Implement real-time dependency risk analysis to detect vulnerabilities in npm and PyPI packages before installation.
Expand support for binding.gyp command expansion to ensure compatibility with a wider range of native modules.
Develop an intuitive user interface that visually highlights potential risks, guiding users through the installation process.
